preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 5 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(Q == int(Q) and 1 <= Q <= 10**5 for Q in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) > 0])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer Q between 1 and 10^5 inclusive, representing the number of queries.

preconditions.expression: all(X == int(X) and 1 <= X <= 10**5 for X in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) > 0])
preconditions.description: Each query X is a positive integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and line.split()[1].isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each query, the output line contains exactly two space-separated integers E and O.

postconditions.expression: all(E == int(E) and O == int(O) and E + O == len(S) for E, O, S in zip([tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()], [set() for _ in range(T)], [set() for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each query, E and O are non-negative integers such that E + O equals the size of the set S after processing the query.

postconditions.expression: all((bin(y).count('1') % 2 == 0) == (y in S_even) for y in S) and all((bin(y).count('1') % 2 == 1) == (y in S_odd) for y in S) for S_even, S_odd, S in zip([{y for y in S if bin(y).count('1') % 2 == 0} for S in S_history], [{y for y in S if bin(y).count('1') % 2 == 1} for S in S_history], S_history)
postconditions.description: For each query, E is the count of elements in S with an even number of 1s in their binary representation, and O is the count of elements with an odd number of 1s.

postconditions.expression: all(S == set() or all(y in S for y in [X] + [y ^ X for y in S_prev if y != X]) for S, S_prev, X in zip(S_history, [set() for _ in range(T)] + S_history[:-1], [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: For each query, the set S is constructed by inserting X and all y ^ X for y in S_prev (where S_prev is the set before the query), ensuring no duplicates.
